title: Canopy
description: Canopy is a desktop app for viewing, editing and publishing phylogenetic trees, modelled on R's ggtree. It reads Newick, NEXUS, phyloXML and HyPhy results; draws layer-based figures with comparative data, PhyloPic silhouettes and geologic timescales; summarizes Bayesian tree sets (consensus, MCC, DensiTree, rogue taxa); imports BayesTraits variable-rates and Fabric results; and exports publication-quality PNG, TIFF, SVG and PDF.
